fact: 华沙战役自1920年8月13日打起，最初在维斯瓦河沿线的北方面军与中方面军阵地展开；8月16日毕苏斯基把原定日期提前一天，从华沙以南约60英里（约97公里）、以维普日河为依托的右翼发起反攻，切断苏军交通线并缴获火炮与物资；8月18日夜图哈切夫斯基的部队开始后撤，战线向北、向东退离华沙。此役通常记为8月13日至25日，战后不久即被称为“维斯瓦河的奇迹”（Cud nad Wisłą）。

sources.title: In Poland World War I Ended in 1923, University of South Florida Digital Commons (ETD)
sources.quote: The Battle of Warsaw commenced on August 13 and was initially fought on the Northern and Central fronts along the line of the Vistula River. On August 16, Piłsudski again changed his plans: advancing the action by one day, he therefore launched a daring counteroffensive from his right flank, sixty miles south of Warsaw, from the base of the Wieprz River. This strike cut the Soviet communication lines ... During the night of August 18, Marshal Tukhachevsky's forces began to withdraw.

sources.title: The Polish-Soviet War, The Battle of Warsaw 1920, Instytut Pamięci Narodowej / gov.pl
sources.quote: Poland's victorious counteroffensive in August 1920 gave rise to the breakdown of the offensive of the Soviet forces.

fact: 华沙解围后波军转入追击：1920年8月25日经过激战攻占格罗德诺，随后向利达推进，9月发生涅曼河战役，9月27日第1军团步兵师攻占利达；10月12日波军进入明斯克，同日里加停火文件签署。8月31日科马鲁夫（Komarów）一战，罗梅尔上校的第1骑兵师击溃布琼尼第1骑兵集团军，被称为20世纪最后一场大规模骑兵战。

sources.title: The Polish-Soviet War, The Battle of Warsaw 1920, Instytut Pamięci Narodowej / gov.pl
sources.quote: After heavy battles, on 25 August 1920, the Poles conquered Grodno, after which the Polish Task Force set off to Lida, to chase their enemy. The 1st Legions' Infantry Division took over Lida on 27 September 1920 ... On 12 October 1920 the Polish Army entered Minsk and, that same day, the ceasefire was signed in Riga, which was formally binding from 18 October 1920.

fact: 波兰与苏俄、苏维埃乌克兰的《初步和约与停战条件》于1920年10月12日在里加签署，停火自10月18日至19日夜间生效，11月2日在利耶帕亚互换批准书；正式和约（《里加条约》）到1921年3月18日才签订。初步和约把巴拉诺维奇—卢尼涅茨—萨尔内—罗夫诺一线铁路与东加利西亚留在波兰一侧，明斯克留在苏俄一侧，波兰并承诺自11月2日起不再支持彼得留拉的部队。

sources.title: Riga, Treaty of, International Encyclopedia of the First World War (1914-1918-online.net)
sources.quote: The treaty was signed on 12 October 1920. ... The armistice agreement stipulated that hostilities stop on the night of 18-19 October.

sources.title: Riga, Treaty of, International Encyclopedia of the First World War (1914-1918-online.net)
sources.quote: The treaty established the so-called Riga border, leaving the strategic railroad that linked Baranowicze-Łuniniec-Sarny-Równe as well as East Galicia on the Polish side and Minsk on the Soviet side.

fact: 1920年7月15日，波兰议会（Sejm）在红军压境的形势下一致通过《土地改革实施法》：约80%的被征收土地分配给无地或少地农民，士兵与伤残军人优先；地主保留上限按1919年7月10日议会决议为180公顷（原普鲁士分区与东部地区为400公顷，城郊与工业区为60公顷）；国家按当地平均市价的一半向地主支付补偿，农民则按市价向国家购地；设立乡与村土地委员会，由同期成立的农业银行提供长期贷款。该法因1921年三月宪法第99条要求全额补偿，后续执行受阻。

sources.title: Wartime Management of the Government of National Defense Headed by Wincenty Witos during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920, HiP 2024
sources.quote: In an effort to encourage the peasants to serve in the army and provide for the defense of the Polish state, on July 15, 1920, the Sejm unanimously passed the Land Reform Act. The Act announced that 80% of the land from the land reform would be allocated for distribution among the landless and smallholders. ... For the land that was bought out, the state was to pay the owners 50% of the average market price in the area. Peasants were to pay the state for land at market prices.

sources.title: Peasants and the Politics of History: Memories of Serfdom in Debates on Land Reform in Early Inter-War Poland, Cambridge University Press
sources.quote: It introduced the compulsory purchase of land by the state and the division of surplus land held by large landowners, as well as mandating that the owners of estates with surplus land were to receive compensation at the sum of half the land's market value.

fact: 华沙1920年12月底的零售价（单位：波兰马克）：黑麦面包86/公斤、大麦粉87/公斤、马铃薯9/公斤、廉价奶酪127/公斤、鸡蛋17/个、牛奶35/升、牛肉135/公斤、廉价茶叶130/公斤、咖啡代用品54/公斤、糖61/公斤、肥皂130/块、火柴2/盒、一套成衣7,300、男靴2,825/双、单间房租30/日。上述为华沙市价，非全国均价；波兰中央统计局（GUS）自1920年起设“工商业工人家庭生活费委员会”，按四口之家（两成人两儿童）约30项商品逐月编制指数，但各市方法不一，指数只可作相对变化比较。

sources.title: The Polish Mark in 1921: A Study in External and Internal Values (Economic Journal offprint, archive.org)
sources.quote: Retail prices (in marks) in Warsaw at the close of each month in 1921. 1920.Dec. ... Rye Bread per kg. 86 ... Beef per kg. 135 ... Rent of one room per day 30 ... The Polish Statistical Bureau issues a monthly figure for the cost of living. It will be seen that the general cost of living increased by four-and-a-half times in the first ten months, and the cost of food rather less than four times.

sources.title: Social movement and economic statistics in interwar Poland, HAL open science
sources.quote: In Poland, in 1920, a 'Commission on the Cost of Living of family workers in industry and commerce' was set up by government decree.

fact: 波兰马克对美元的年终汇率：1919年1月31日为11马克/美元，1919年12月31日为110，1920年12月31日为590，1921年12月31日为12,922.50；即1920年一年内对美元再贬约5.4倍。另一口径（NBER）称1919年中至1920年底马克对美元贬值约30倍、同期货币存量增加约40倍，两项统计的基期与取价日不同，不可直接相除比较。

sources.title: Poland's Greatest Inflations of Past Century, Optimum. Economic Studies 4/2018, University of Białystok
sources.quote: TABLE 1 Exchange rate of US dollar to Polish mark ... 31.01.1919 11 ... 31.12.1920 590.00 ... 31.12.1921 12,922.50 ... Source: [Zientara et al., 1973, p. 568].

sources.title: Stopping Hyperinflations Past and Present, NBER Working Paper No. 1810
sources.quote: A hyperinflation was already under way by the beginning of 1920: the mark had depreciated against the dollar by a factor of 30 from the middle of 1919 to the end of 1920, while the currency stock had risen over the same period by a factor of 40.

fact: 复国初期波兰境内同时流通德马克、奥匈克朗、卢布与波兰马克四种货币；1919年11月政府法令规定波兰马克为全国唯一法偿，1920年中期生效（上西里西亚形式上迟至1923年11月1日）。波兰马克由德国占领当局1916年12月设立的波兰国家贷款局（Polska Krajowa Kasa Pożyczkowa）发行，受财政部长管辖；因税收有限，对苏战争支出主要靠印钞，1920年流通量约50亿马克。

sources.title: Poland's Greatest Inflations of Past Century, Optimum. Economic Studies 4/2018
sources.quote: Therefore, in November 1919, the government decreed that the Polish mark would become the sole legal tender in the entire country, which took effect in mid-1920 ... (in Upper Silesia, formally, on the 1st of November, 1923).

sources.title: Stopping Hyperinflations Past and Present, NBER Working Paper No. 1810
sources.quote: The new government succeeded by 1920 in replacing the foreign currencies and instituting the Polish mark as the medium of exchange and sole legal tender. The Polish mark was issued by the Polish State Loan Bank, which operated under the authority of the Finance Minister. Poland was at war with Soviet Russia until 1920. Tax collection was small, and the printing of marks the main method of financing.

fact: 1920年7月1日，波兰议会通过设立“国防委员会”（Rada Obrony Państwa）的法律，由该委员会决定一切与战争及缔结和约有关的事务。委员会由国家元首任主席，成员包括议会议长、总理、十个议会政党各两名代表、政府代表与军方代表。这意味着1920年夏波兰处于议会授权的战时特别体制之下，日常行政仍依1919年2月20日《小宪法》运作，正式共和国宪法到1921年3月17日才通过。

sources.title: Wartime Management of the Government of National Defense Headed by Wincenty Witos during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920, HiP 2024
sources.quote: On July 1, 1920, the Sejm passed a law creating the Council for the Defense of the State, which was to decide on all matters relating to the war and the establishment of peace. It consisted of: the Chief of the State as the Chairman, the Marshal of the Sejm and the Prime Minister, as well as two representatives each from ten Polish parliamentary parties, government representatives, and the military.

fact: 1920年2月波兰接管《凡尔赛条约》划归的波美拉尼亚与沿海地区后，海军部海事司工程处处长 Tadeusz Wenda 于6月20日提交报告，判定在但泽（格但斯克）以外，格丁尼亚与奥克西维之间的平地最适合建港；临时港随即开工。正式的《格丁尼亚海港建设法》到1922年9月23日才由议会通过，1923年4月29日临时港开港，1923年8月13日首艘远洋轮（法国船“Kentucky”号）进港。常见说法称“1920年已通过建港法”，与法案通过时间不符。

sources.title: Gdynia 1920-1939: Poland's Gateway to the World, CEJSH (Polish Historical Journal)
sources.quote: Following a memorandum presented by Wenda to the government on 20 June 1920, the construction of the first, temporary port, started. ... An act on the construction of the seaport in Gdynia was passed in the Polish Parliament on 23 September 1922, and on 29 April 1923 the port was officially inaugurated.

sources.title: The Port of Gdynia, European Business Club Poland
sources.quote: On the 20th June 1920 Tadeusz Wenda submitted a "report of activities". ... he stated that "Among other locations by the Baltic seaside I Poland (not mentioning Gdańsk), the most suitable place for building a military port (as well as commercial port of needed) is Gdynia".

fact: 波兰的斑疹伤寒流行自1916年延续至1923年。1920年7月，波兰政府撤销效率低下的中央防疫委员会（Cekadur），改设“抗击流行病最高特别专员”，由 Emil Godlewski Jr. 教授出任，拥有动员防疫物资生产、发布防疫条例、任命地区专员等广泛权力。到1920年底，该公署运营188所医院、9,245张病床，加上红十字会与军医院合计12,915张。美国救济署（ARA）在1919—1921年间向波兰投入约2亿美元（占其资金20%），1920年运入约20万吨面粉。

sources.title: The Maturation of the International Health Crisis Response: The Polish Typhus Epidemic of 1916-1923, MDPI (2025)
sources.quote: in July 1920, the Polish government created the office of the Supreme Extraordinary Commissioner for the Fight Against Epidemics ... By the end of 1920, the Commissariat was operating 188 hospitals with 9245 beds, with additional beds in Red Cross and military hospitals, for a total of 12,915 beds.

sources.title: "It was good to fight for Poland!", Instytut Pamięci Narodowej
sources.quote: Poland was allotted 20% of the ARA's funds, i.e. USD 200 million in the years 1919 - 1921 ... In 1920 we received 200 thousand tonnes of flour from the USA, with the assurance of this amount being doubled.
